 Milwaukee's struggles continued Thursday with a 124-114 loss to Portland, extending its losing streak to 12 games. The Bucks kept the game competitive through three quarters, trailing 96-92 entering the fourth, but couldn't keep up with the Trail Blazers down the stretch. Former Milwaukee guard Damian Lillard scored 33 points in his return to the city, while Scoot Henderson added 27 for Portland. Tyler Herro led the Bucks with 19 points, and Nate Ament and Kasparas Jakucionis each contributed 18.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Philadelphia has won four straight games after overcoming a 17-point deficit to beat Orlando 121-116 on Wednesday. The 76ers fell behind 40-27 in the first quarter but gradually worked their way back despite playing without Tyrese Maxey and Jaylen Brown. Joel Embiid led Philadelphia with 26 points, while VJ Edgecombe scored a season-high 24, including 13 in the fourth quarter. Edgecombe's three-pointer with 1:36 remaining gave the 76ers a 114-112 lead, and Anfernee Simons later made another three to help secure the win.
